name: What preparation is needed before garage flooring installation?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before garage flooring installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper preparation is crucial for a successful garage flooring installation. This typically involves clearing out the garage completely. The concrete slab must be thoroughly cleaned to remove all dirt, oil, grease, and other contaminants. Depending on the existing condition, we may perform diamond grinding or acid etching to create a porous surface for optimal adhesion. Any cracks or spalling will be repaired and leveled before coating application. This ensures a strong bond and a smooth, durable finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Preparation for garage flooring includes clearing the space, thorough cleaning, and often diamond grinding or acid etching the concrete, followed by crack repair.
